import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
region = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [46, -12], [50, -12], [50, -15], [46, -15], [46, -12]
])

# Target period
target_start = '2018-12-01'
target_end = '2019-02-01'  # Includes all of Jan 2019

# Baseline periods (all Dec-Jan from 2000-2019)
baseline_years = list(range(2000, 2020))

# 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS precipitation
def get_seasonal_precip(year):
    """Get total precipitation for Dec-Jan season of given year"""
    start = f'{year}-12-01'
    end = f'{year+1}-02-01'  # Includes all of Jan
    collection = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \
        .filterDate(start, end) \
        .filterBounds(region) \
        .select('precipitation')
    
    if collection.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None
    
    # Sum precipitation over the season
    total_precip = collection.sum()
    
    # Calculate mean over region
    stats = total_precip.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=region,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    precip = stats.get('precipitation').getInfo()
    return precip

# Get target precipitation
target_precip = get_seasonal_precip(2018)
if target_precip is None:
    print("No target data found")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# Get baseline precipitation (all years 2000-2019)
baseline_precip = []
for year in baseline_years:
    precip = get_seasonal_precip(year)
    if precip is not None:
        baseline_precip.append(precip)

if len(baseline_precip) == 0:
    print("No baseline data found")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# Calculate baseline average
baseline_avg = sum(baseline_precip) / len(baseline_precip)

# 3. Validation & Final Answer
print(f"Target (2018-19): {target_precip:.1f} mm")
print(f"Baseline avg: {baseline_avg:.1f} mm")
print(f"Years in baseline: {len(baseline_precip)}")

if target_precip is None or baseline_avg is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif target_precip < baseline_avg:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
